title: Antigua Guatemala Cathedral

terrainReference.basis: Fixed west/front plaza approach beyond the native west facade, selected before terrain acquisition. Approximate datum only; intrinsic steps/footings are bounded and source relief is not flattened.

note: Complete native cathedral perimeter with standing western/southern Parish of San Jose and full roofless eastern ruins. Exact native boundary/roof voids guide extent; CC0 Qualla portal and CC0 front/nave views guide facade, open arches, compound piers and broken vault remnants. Heights, structural sections, hidden roofs, sculpture and host-ground contact remain photographic estimates. Lost towers/domes, adjacent buildings, modern furnishings and landscape excluded.
